title: Polynomial-time EFX for three additive agents
area: Algorithmic game theory, mechanism design and fair division
formal: Can a complete EFX allocation of indivisible goods among three agents with nonnegative rational additive valuations be found in time polynomial in the input bit length?
context:
Pseudopolynomial running time depends on value magnitudes and does not meet this target. General EFX existence remains a separate card.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: The smallest unresolved computational case for exact EFX after existence for three agents was established.
